findings.finding: The ECR mirror is gated on the three AWS_* repository variables but not on the ref. Repository variables are visible to same-repo pull_request runs (and non-main workflow_dispatch); the publish role is specified to trust repo:sjawhar/legion:ref:refs/heads/main only (spec Requirements; docs/kubernetes.md:90-91), so once the variables exist every PR-head build attempts AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity with subject repo:sjawhar/legion:pull_request, is denied, and the job fails after the GHCR push succeeded — the PR's image check is red on every PR and the 'ECR mirror failure note' fires each time. PR-head sha- images would also be mirrored into ECR, which is not intended. Latent today (variables unset).
findings.fix: In 'Decide ECR mirror', before the variable checks: `if [ "$GITHUB_REF" != "refs/heads/main" ]; then echo enabled=false >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo 'ECR mirror skipped: not a main run' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"; exit 0; fi` (the same $GITHUB_REF test Compute tags uses at line 87); docs/kubernetes.md ECR section: 'on main runs only'. Extend the implementer's four-shape shell simulation with the pull_request shape for this step.

findings.finding: Comment attributes OMP's native-module download to the probe step; measured on this host (same pin, fresh HOME) the ~345 MB download happens in `omp plugin install` (7–35 s), and the probes take ~8 s with natives present. The order is load-bearing: defaultRunner (state/fetch.ts) kills any single omp invocation after 30 s, so a download inside the first probe would be a definitive 'does not expose pi.agents' failure.
findings.fix: Reword the comment to attribute the download to step 1 and state that it must precede probe-image because of the 30 s runner ceiling.

findings.finding: Remedy says `gh run rerun ${GITHUB_RUN_ID}`. For a release.yaml-called run a whole-run rerun re-executes `cli` at the same github.sha, which now sees its own cli-vX tag on the bump commit → release-bump.sh range empty → skip → cli_version/release_tag empty → the retried image publishes sha- only with no :<version> tag and no release-body append.
findings.fix: `gh run rerun ${GITHUB_RUN_ID} --failed` in both remedy strings and the docs line; --failed keeps cli's recorded outputs.

findings.finding: `secrets: inherit` is unnecessary: worker-image.yaml declares no workflow_call secrets and reads only secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN, which a called workflow gets automatically; inherit hands DEPLOY_KEY and every other repo secret to a PR-authored Dockerfile build job. The spec's Design row names `secrets: inherit`, so removing it is the architect's one-word spec edit.
findings.fix: Delete the line (recommended); or keep and record why.

findings.finding: 'Two prerequisites … both one-time' followed by three bullets; GHCR visibility is a post-first-push action, not a build prerequisite.
findings.fix: Move GHCR visibility to its own sentence or fix the count.

findings.finding: Everything the image-time probe proved lives under HOME (plugin link + lock at ~/.omp/profiles/legion/plugins, natives at ~/.omp/natives). A volume mounted at /home/legion (emptyDir, or readOnlyRootFilesystem + HOME volume) shadows both silently; LEGION-24 needs the constraint stated.
findings.fix: Add one clause: mount writable volumes below the profile directory, never at /home/legion itself.
